title: 17 August 1968: George and Pattie Harrison fly to Greece
content:
George Harrison and his wife Pattie Harrison flew to Greece on this day for a brief holiday.

They were accompanied on the trip by The Beatles’ assistant Mal Evans. The trio returned to London on 21 August 1968.

Page last updated: 2 October 2011
